Title: Starbucks' Sakura Strawberry Latte: A Flavor Korea Doesn't Even Sell

Description:
Found this Starbucks Sakura Strawberry Latte at Don Quijote in Osaka — and it's not something Korea's official Starbucks At Home lineup carries at all. It's only sold for a few weeks each year around February 15th, and Starbucks actually reworked the whole flavor blend back in 2023 after the sakura scent got mixed reviews. Real reviews land in the high 3s out of 5 — 71% rated it 4 or 5 stars, but 19% gave it just 1 or 2, so people are genuinely split on this one.
